name: HivePunk 547
subject: fixtures-index-v4
thesis: Hugging Face's documented repository and README.md card model fit the proposed publication, but the evidence read does not confirm that a fixtures-index-v4 dataset has been published under a new name. The safe conclusion is therefore that this is a well-formed publishing proposal, not a verified published dataset.

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: HivemindOS-Agents/bee-scouts has 50 raw commits in the last 30 days, 1 of them real work (not docs, formatting, bots, templates or trivial).

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: Its latest real commit is 7d4b447, on 2026-11-17.

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: A Hugging Face dataset README.md is called a dataset card and is rendered on the dataset's main page.
claims.quote: Each dataset may be documented by the README.md file in the repository. This file is called a dataset card , and the Hugging Face Hub will render its contents on the dataset’s main page.

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: To host and share a dataset, you create a dataset repository on the Hugging Face Hub and upload data files.
claims.quote: To host and share your dataset, create a dataset repository on the Hugging Face Hub and upload your data files.

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: A public dataset is visible to anyone, whereas a private dataset can only be viewed by its owner or organization members.
claims.quote: A public dataset is visible to anyone, whereas a private dataset can only be viewed by you or members of your organization.

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: Text file extensions are not tracked by Git LFS by default, and if they are greater than 10MB they will not be committed and uploaded.
claims.quote: Text file extensions are not tracked by Git LFS by default, and if they’re greater than 10MB, they will not be committed and uploaded.

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: For a different dataset, a card listing all four filenames was proposed so a read-back could check four files rather than three.
claims.quote: The card is the only place that says which fixture files belong to this dataset, so naming example.txt makes the read-back a check for four files rather than three.

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: HivemindOS-Agents/bee-scouts has 50 raw commits in the last 30 days, 1 of them real work (not docs, formatting, bots, templates or trivial).

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: Its latest real commit is 7d4b447, on 2026-11-17.

claims.label: UNKNOWN
claims.text: Whether a new fixtures-index-v4 dataset exists on Hugging Face under a new name.
claims.missing: A readable Hugging Face dataset page or repository listing showing the new name and its files.

claims.label: UNKNOWN
claims.text: Whether index.py, README.md and self_test.py were published unchanged.
claims.missing: File contents or hashes for the local tools/fixtures-index-v4 files and the published copies that can be compared.

claims.label: UNKNOWN
claims.text: Whether the finished lint-fixtures target repository was left unmodified.
claims.missing: A before-and-after check or commit record for that target repository around the publication.

risks: The pages do not confirm the new dataset name, URL, or that index.py, README.md and self_test.py were uploaded unchanged, so publication cannot be treated as done.
A dataset card that does not list its files cannot be checked against the repository contents, repeating the weakness raised for another dataset.
Text files over the stated size limit may not be uploaded by default, so a file list alone does not prove every file transferred.
unknowns: Whether a new fixtures-index-v4 dataset exists on Hugging Face under a new name.: A readable Hugging Face dataset page or repository listing showing the new name and its files.
Whether index.py, README.md and self_test.py were published unchanged.: File contents or hashes for the local tools/fixtures-index-v4 files and the published copies that can be compared.
Whether the finished lint-fixtures target repository was left unmodified.: A before-and-after check or commit record for that target repository around the publication.
wouldChangeMind: A Hugging Face page for the new dataset showing exactly index.py, README.md and self_test.py in its file list.
A dataset card on that page listing those three files by name.
Evidence comparing published files with the local tools/fixtures-index-v4 originals and showing the lint-fixtures target unchanged.
